title: Really Useful
content: When the art blog "Making a Mark" handed out the year-end awards, I was thrilled that GurneyJourney was recognized with the "The FAQs and Answers Really Useful Medal."If you haven't checked out Making a Mark, give it a visit. It is full of practical and helpful information, not only about picturemaking, but exhibitions, art resources, and developing an art career.(Thanks, Katherine)
